name: Botanical Gardens
description: The oldest botanical gardens in the Western Hemisphere, featuring rare tropical plants and the St. Vincent Parrot.

name: Fort Charlotte
description: A historic 19th-century military fort offering panoramic views of Kingstown and the surrounding Caribbean Sea.

name: La Soufrière Volcano
description: An active volcano featuring hiking trails through lush rainforests up to a breathtaking summit crater view.

name: Dark View Falls
description: Two beautiful cascading waterfalls nestled in rainforest scenery, accessible via a picturesque bamboo bridge.

name: Wallilabou Bay
description: A scenic natural cove renowned as a primary filming site for Disney's Pirates of the Caribbean franchise.

name: Bequia Island
description: A charming island known for boat building, vibrant harbor towns, and crystal-clear swimming beaches.

name: Tobago Cays
description: An archipelago of uninhabited cays surrounded by turquoise lagoons, rich coral reefs, and green sea turtles.

name: Kingstown Market
description: A bustling outdoor marketplace filled with fresh local fruits, vegetables, ground provisions, and artisanal goods.
